storyCards.headline: Hot For Teacher: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Van Halen's "Hot For Teacher" reached #56 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Hot for Teacher" is a song by the American rock band Van Halen, taken from their sixth studio album, 1984.

The song was written by band members Eddie Van Halen, Alex Van Halen, Michael Anthony and David Lee Roth, and produced by Ted Templeman.

It was released as the fourth and final single from the album in October 1984, and was the final single released during the band's 1974–1985 era.

The song peaked at #56 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 7 weeks on the chart.
